description: Canonical staging smoke targets for V2-FE-148. Each entry is a real production surface that must respond predictably in a staged deployment: a public page (200 HTML) or a canonical HTTP route handler. FAIL-CLOSED: a smoke check only passes when the live target returns the expected status within its latency budget using a real probe — a missing target, unexpected status, or unbounded latency is a FAIL, never a fabricated pass. Enforced at build time by `scripts/verify-staging-smoke.mjs` (canonical artifact validation + on-disk route-handler presence) and at runtime by `e2e/staging-smoke.spec.ts`. Method-gated endpoints (e.g. identity-rp is POST-only) expect 405 on the GET smoke probe: 405 proves the handler is mounted, whereas 404 would mean the route is missing.
